title: Agent-Native by Design: A Programming Language for Agentic Applications
abstract: arXiv:2611.21298v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Building agentic applications requires combining large language model (LLM) operations, workflow structure and application state, and model-guided routing. With SDKs and agent frameworks, developers connect these components through supporting code that prepares model inputs, propagates state, and dispatches model-selected steps. Workflow changes can require coordinated updates to this code, increasing development and testing effort. Splitting execution logic between application code and framework internals also limits compiler visibility into control flow and state dependencies, hindering automatic optimization. We introduce Agent-Native Programming, which unifies these three components with shared execution semantics. We realize this approach in Jac, a Python-superset language, through "by llm()" for typed model operations and tool use, Object-Spatial Programming for workflow structure and state, and "visit ... by llm()" for model-gui

translated_title: 以智能体原生为设计理念：一种面向智能体应用的编程语言
translated_abstract: 构建智能体应用需要将大语言模型（LLM）操作、工作流结构与应用状态、以及模型引导的路由相结合。在使用SDK和智能体框架时，开发者需要通过辅助代码来连接这些组件，例如准备模型输入、传播状态以及分发模型选择的步骤。工作流的变更往往需要对这些代码进行协调更新，从而增加开发和测试的工作量。此外，将执行逻辑分散在应用代码与框架内部之间，限制了编译器对控制流和状态依赖的可见性，阻碍了自动优化。我们提出了智能体原生编程，以共享的执行语义将这三个组件统一起来。我们在Python超集语言Jac中实现了这一方法：通过"by llm()"实现类型化的模型操作与工具使用，通过对象空间编程实现工作流结构与状态，并通过"visit ... by llm()"实现模型引导的路由。
tldr: 该论文提出“智能体原生编程”理念，并在Python超集语言Jac中通过"by llm()"、对象空间编程和"visit ... by llm()"等机制，将大语言模型操作、工作流结构与状态、模型引导路由统一在同一套执行语义下，从而简化智能体应用的开发并提升编译器对程序进行自动优化的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Agent-Native Programming, realized in the Python-superset language Jac, which unifies LLM operations, workflow structure and state, and model-guided routing under shared execution semantics—via "by llm()", Object-Spatial Programming, and "visit ... by llm()"—simplifying agentic application development and enabling compiler-based automatic optimization.
